execution.sam3_selectors: Fresh current-code selector replay on frozen SAM3 review proposals; unchanged response order and dN IDs; no new detector request, tracker or central recovery.
execution.sam3_prompt_difference: Review proposal nouns include wine glass and omit can relative to the production semantic prompt.
execution.dis: Fresh local CPU inference on all unique selected originals; pinned LiteRT model, four interpreter threads, 120 second timeout.
execution.configuration: Default select_variant with supplied instances; tap=None; aim=None. Exact frozen fallback unchanged.

scoring.target_agreement: Selected dN equals an accepted target, or exact full-frame/context expectation. DIS has no native target ID and is never assigned semantic accuracy.
scoring.proxies: Target mask retention >=95% and other bottle mask retention <=10%, excluding proposal duplicates at IoU>=0.5; masks and owners unreviewed.
scoring.label_proxy: Wine-label proposals with >=80% of their mask inside the proposed target; report retained fraction and area. Ownership and legibility are not ground truth.
scoring.usability: Target agreement alone is not crop usefulness. No automatic PASS for legibility. Human crop-usability review remains pending for every result.
scoring.confirmed_annotation_accuracy: Not reported: zero human-approved masks. Separate scene-confirmed and pending-scene cohorts.

provenance: Selected cases only. Rejected, blocked and canceled attempts are retained in source-data JSON provenance and excluded from accepted-scene denominators.
limitations: Synthetic development images, including previously used development cases; not independent real-world accuracy.
Fifty scene approvals do not approve detector masks or their ownership; all mask metrics are provisional.
The 102 pending scenes, including GP11 and SP01, are exploratory only.
No visual target, ground truth, fallback contract or historical report is changed by this run.
